name: helm_repository
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes Helm repository (Flux HelmRepository).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this Helm repository.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Helm repository resource.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this Helm repository to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this Helm repository belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the Helm repository is created in.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Flux HelmRepository CRD apiVersion. Override if your cluster's Flux serves a different version (e.g. source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2).

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: URL of the Helm repository (e.g. https://charts.example.com or oci://registry.example.com/charts).

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: Interval at which the repository index is fetched (Go duration, e.g. 5m, 1h).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Repository type: "default" (HTTP/HTTPS) or "oci".

attributes.name: oci_provider
attributes.description: OCI provider for authentication (e.g. generic, aws, azure, gcp). Only used when type is oci.

attributes.name: secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding credentials for the repository.

attributes.name: cert_secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding TLS certificate data for the repository.

attributes.name: pass_credentials
attributes.description: Pass credentials to all domains the repository redirects to.

attributes.name: insecure
attributes.description: Allow connecting to an HTTP (non-TLS) OCI registry.

attributes.name: suspend
attributes.description: Suspend reconciliation of the repository.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the Helm repository.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the Helm repository.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.
